answer: The 2025 target was a 15% reduction in net Scope 1 and 2 emissions from the adjusted 2018 baseline. Gross adjusted emissions were 14% below 2018, so the threshold was not reached on a gross basis. Net adjusted emissions were 17% below baseline after high-integrity offsets, so the stated net target was reached. Offsets therefore changed the disclosed outcome from 14% gross to 17% net; they did not demonstrate a 17% gross abatement reduction.

evidence.quote: Reduce our absolute Scope 1 and 2 greenhouse gas emissions by 15% by 2025 ... adjusted gross ... 14% below 2018 ... After applying high-integrity offsets ... 17% below our baseline.
After applying high-integrity offsets, our net adjusted Scope 1 and 2 emissions are 17% below our baseline.
2025 target: Reduce our net Scope 1 and 2 emissions by 15% by 2025
